title: Sparkly book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Book cover -->
  <rect x="22" y="28" width="56" height="48" rx="4" fill="#7B4FD4"/>
  <!-- Book cover lighter edge -->
  <rect x="22" y="28" width="56" height="48" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#B79BFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <rect x="22" y="28" width="10" height="48" rx="3" fill="#5A34A8"/>
  <!-- Book spine highlight -->
  <rect x="24" y="30" width="3" height="44" rx="1.5" fill="#9575E0"/>
  <!-- Pages -->
  <rect x="34" y="32" width="40" height="40" rx="2" fill="#FFF4D6"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <rect x="39" y="40" width="28" height="2" rx="1" fill="#E8D5A8"/>
  <rect x="39" y="46" width="28" height="2" rx="1" fill="#E8D5A8"/>
  <rect x="39" y="52" width="28" height="2" rx="1" fill="#E8D5A8"/>
  <rect x="39" y="58" width="20" height="2" rx="1" fill="#E8D5A8"/>
  <!-- Book bookmark ribbon -->
  <path d="M62 76 L62 88 L66 84 L70 88 L70 76 Z" fill="#FF6B9D"/>
  <!-- Book clasp -->
  <rect x="72" y="46" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#FFD94A"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="52" r="2" fill="#FFB800"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 1 top left -->
  <path d="M14 18 L16 24 L22 26 L16 28 L14 34 L12 28 L6 26 L12 24 Z" fill="#FFE94A"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 top right -->
  <path d="M82 14 L84 20 L90 22 L84 24 L82 30 L80 24 L74 22 L80 20 Z" fill="#7DF9FF"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 bottom left -->
  <path d="M12 72 L13.5 77 L18.5 78.5 L13.5 80 L12 85 L10.5 80 L5.5 78.5 L10.5 77 Z" fill="#FF9BF0"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 bottom right -->
  <path d="M88 70 L89.5 75 L94.5 76.5 L89.5 78 L88 83 L86.5 78 L81.5 76.5 L86.5 75 Z" fill="#9BFFB0"/>
  <!-- Tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="38" r="2" fill="#FFE94A"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="36" r="2" fill="#7DF9FF"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="84" r="2" fill="#FF9BF0"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="88" r="2" fill="#9BFFB0"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="16" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
